question: Which of the following is NOT an important and direct contribution of a well-developed commercial banking sector?

options.text: Facilitation of successful implementation of the monetary policy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Establishment of the agricultural market**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Commercial banking is a cornerstone of the financial system, offering a range of services to** individuals and businesses.**
 
• These banks accept deposits, provide loans, and facilitate financial transactions.
 
• They play a crucial role in economic growth by mobilizing savings and channeling them into **productive investments.**
 
• Commercial banks are categorized into various types, including public sector banks, private sector banks, foreign banks, and regional rural banks.
 
• Each type has its unique characteristics and caters to specific customer segments.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulates and supervises the commercial banking sector to ensure its stability and soundness.
 
• The RBI implements monetary policy to control inflation and stimulate **economic activity.**
 
• It also sets guidelines for** lending rates, reserve requirements, and other banking practices.**
